newsitem.title: UK: Japanese stocks edge higher in quiet London trade.
newsitem.headline: Japanese stocks edge higher in quiet London trade.

text.p: Japanese stocks were slightly higher in quiet London trading, tracking gains on Wall Street Friday but lacking fresh company news to give the market a fresh impetus, traders said.
The Nikkei 50 index of leading Japanese shares trading in London was up 1.93 points or 0.14 percent at 1,377.01 by 1415 GMT, after the Nikkei 225 in Tokyo rose some 50 points or 0.25 percent.
"There is not a huge amount going on, things are deathly quiet," said one trader at a Japanese securities house in London.

Some said it was a bullish signal that the Nikkei 225 had bounced back last week to stay above the 20,000 level, though others said it could come under renewed downward pressure ahead of interim results from Japanese companies next month.
"I think we will see it back below 20,000, it is only a matter of time," said another trader here.
